XSokoban level data attribution

The 50 source XSokoban layouts retained in games/sokoban/level-data.js were
imported from (the runtime exposes layouts 31–50 as 20 challenge levels):
https://github.com/isdsi/box_pusher/blob/master/levels_data.sok

The source repository publishes its project under the MIT License. The layout
collection is identified as “XSokoban” in that source file. This attribution is
kept with the game documentation; the runtime uses only the normalized maps.
